title: Exploration workspace
status: gate met - AC-1..AC-4 met: every count is a COUNT over records and a failed read returns no counts at all; each source link is decided by the shell's page-permission answer, with the feature that will add a missing page named; only prospects with a missing risk element are counted; and the exploration persona's landing route is derived from the RBAC seed's DEFAULT_LANDING_ROUTE and guarded against drift

implementation.service: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Data/Exploration/OgExplorationWorkspace.cs (OgFunnelStage, OgExplorationKpis, OgExplorationLink, OgExplorationSnapshot, IOgExplorationWorkspace, OgExplorationWorkspace, BuildLinks, IsIncomplete, FieldClause)
implementation.page: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop/Views/ExplorationWorkspacePageView.cs (route 'exploration': header, KPI sentence, incomplete-risk strip, permission-gated source buttons, funnel grid, inbox state)
implementation.persona: Core/OgRoleNames.cs (ExplorationGeologist), Core/OgPersonaLanding.cs (persona row plus RouteFor, which maps an RBAC web route to the desktop module route)
implementation.wiring: OgBootstrapper (IOgExplorationWorkspace), OgApplication.ExplorationWorkspace, catalog 'exploration' (OgModuleKeys.Exploration), factory, en + ar labels
implementation.tests: test/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Tests/ExplorationWorkspaceTests.cs (15, no database, incl. the RBAC-seed guard) + ExplorationWorkspaceGatewayTests.cs (1 opt-in, real SQLite)

integration.database: SQLite PROSPECT, PROSPECT_WORKFLOW_STAGE, PROSPECT_RISK_ASSESSMENT, PLAY, LEAD and WELL
integration.funnel: SCREENING 2 and DRILLING 1 for FIELD-1 (three distinct prospects, ordered by stage sequence); the other field's prospect never appears
integration.kpis: plays 2, leads 3, wells planned 1, wells drilling 1 - each from its own table, with an ABANDONED well not counted
integration.incomplete_risk: exactly PROS-2 (no assessment) and PROS-4 (RESERVOIR_RISK null); PROS-1 and PROS-3 have complete assessments and are not counted
integration.field_scope: FIELD-1 by id and "South" by name both resolve; a field with no records is success with zeros, not a failure
integration.failed_read: with PROSPECT_WORKFLOW_STAGE dropped the load returns a failure with a reference and no snapshot - the page then shows the failure state, not zeros
integration.links: with a permission answer that allows only 'wells', only that link is available; the prospect board is unavailable and its reason names EXP-02

gates.AC-1 Counts come from records; a failed: pass - every number is a COUNT over PROSPECT_WORKFLOW_STAGE, PLAY, LEAD or WELL, and the SQLite test matches them to the seeded rows (a fourth prospect with no stage and a fifth in another field are both excluded). Each query's provider error is checked immediately after it runs, so a later successful query cannot overwrite it: with PROSPECT_WORKFLOW_STAGE dropped the load fails with a reference and a null snapshot, and the page clears its counts and shows the failure state.
gates.AC-2 Every source link is gated by its o: pass - the workspace is given the shell's page-permission function and builds the link list from it (BuildLinks); a link is Available exactly when the predicate answers true, and the SQLite test with a 'wells only' predicate offers only that link. A route with no page in this build is unavailable and its reason names the feature that adds it (EXP-02, EXP-04, EXP-05, LSE-01); the page renders a button only for the available links.
gates.AC-3 The incomplete-risk warning counts: pass - a prospect is counted when it has no PROSPECT_RISK_ASSESSMENT row or any of TRAP_RISK, RESERVOIR_RISK, SEAL_RISK, SOURCE_RISK, TIMING_RISK is NULL. IsIncomplete is unit-tested for a complete assessment, no assessment, each single missing element, and zeroed values; the SQLite test sees exactly PROS-2 and PROS-4 and neither PROS-1 nor PROS-3.
gates.AC-4 The persona landing route matches t: pass - OgPersonaLanding gains the ExplorationGeologist persona on route 'exploration' and a RouteFor mapping (the module segment before a trailing 'dashboard'). A guard test reads Beep.OilandGas.UserManagement/Services/DefaultSecuritySeedService.cs, extracts the EXPLORATION_GEOLOGIST route, and asserts the mapped route equals the persona row and is a real catalog page, so moving either side fails the test. The smoke resolves the persona through the real navigation service and gets 'exploration'.

limits: The workspace reads the field by id or name over the columns each table has (PROSPECT.FIELD_ID/PRIMARY_FIELD_ID, PLAY/LEAD.FIELD_ID, WELL.ASSIGNED_FIELD); a database that stores the field in another column shows zero for that field.
The persona inbox is a stated placeholder: WFL-05 is not built, so the page says the inbox arrives with WFL-05 instead of inventing items.

Only three of the plan's seven sources exist as pages today (well index, stratigraphy, well path); the prospect board, seismic, well-program approval and lease register are listed as unavailable with the feature that adds them.
Wells planned and drilling are counted from WELL.CURRENT_STATUS values PLANNED and DRILLING; a database that uses different status words for the same states shows zero.
The page has no field or period switcher; it uses the signed-in session's field, period and persona, and a Refresh button re-reads them.
The funnel shows stages that have at least one prospect; a prospect with no workflow-stage row is excluded from the funnel and is not reported as an extra stage.
The page is exercised by construction (the smoke builds every catalog page and audits it) and by unit/integration tests; no automated click drives its buttons.
